Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Removed Studium Porter route calibration, saved territory and position settings, vnavmesh movement, route states, and the movement timing control. Porter now begins prize fulfilment wherever you manually position him, while retaining the normal identity, safety, inventory, winner, and trade checks.
